contexts.text: The third state (of regeneration) is a state of repentance. Described. AC 29:end.
The Lord's mercy is described by to repent (). AC 587. AC 588, Explained, Illustrated.
My repentances () = much mercy.
To repent regards wisdom; to grieve at heart, love.
The Spirits began to be sorry that they had not believed...
The interiors (when closed by adultery) cannot be opened, except by serious repentance.
Believes he is pure... when he has once performed repentance, and done the imposed penance...
(Supposes that all can be compelled to perform repentance.)
When he receives the Bread, he thinks... of repentance and amendment of life.
Jehovah's saying that He repented. Explained.
To put on sackcloth and roll in ashes, represented... repentance; for the primary of (repentance) is to acknowledge that from self is nothing but evil and falsity... AE 637:7.
Unless he performs serious repentance.
An internal acknowledgement of evil, which, when recalled by the Lord, becomes confession, and finally repentance.
Supplication and repentance. Signified, Explained.
Repentance and acknowledgement of the Divine things of the Church. Signified, Explained.
Lest the people repent when they see war () = that they will decline from truth.
The Doctrine of (Repentance). General article... He who wants to be saved must confess his sins and perform repentance.
To perform repentance is... to desist from sins, and lead a new life according to the precepts of faith.
He who leads a life of faith performs repentance daily; for he reflects upon (his) evils, acknowledges them, bewares of them, and supplicates the Lord for aid...
The repentance which takes place in a free state avails, but not that... in a state of compulsion. Explained.
The repentance of the mouth and not of the life is not repentance. Explained.
After man has... performed repentance, he must remain constant in good... or else he profanes.
Damnation although... he promises repentance. Signified, Explained.
Sins are not remitted unless the man performs serious repentance...
Hypocrites cannot perform repentance. Explained.
The removal of evil possible only by actual repentance, which is that of the life, and is effected through spiritual temptations, which are the grievous things of repentance.
Hence those who will perform repentance, must see and acknowledge their evils, and thus live a life of truth.
The return of the prodigal to his father... = repentance of heart. AE 279:6.
Then to shun evil and falsity, and be averse to them, is repentance...
The removal of sins with those who... have performed repentance, was represented by the scapegoat...

Repent Thou upon Thy people () = mercy for them... That to repent = to have mercy, is because Jehovah never repents... repentance is applicable only to him who does not know the future... Illustrated.
Repentance after death is not possible. From experience.
On repentance. Chapter.

The man who explores himself in order to perform repentance, must explore his thoughts and the intentions of his will... Those who do not (do this) cannot perform repentance; for they think and will afterwards as before...
(Repentance followed by profanation.) Signified.
Sins cannot be taken away except by actual repentance, which is, that the man sees his sins, implores the Lord's aid, and desists from them.
See Remit.
Those have the faith of God who perform repentance; but the faith of man who do not perform repentance...
That the Lord and His disciples preached repentance and the remission of sins. Illustrated.
Repentance as described by the Lord. Illustrated.
It is a common thing in all religion, that man must... perform repentance... DP 114, Explained.
As this Reciprocal... is with man from the Lord, He says that man must perform repentance; and no one can perform repentance except as of himself. Illustrated. DP 114:3.
Hence confirmed evil and falsity... can be extirpated only in this world, by repentance.
Think about this... and you will see that repentance from sins is the way to Heaven; and that faith separated from repentance is not faith...
Without this appearance, repentance from sins is not possible.
These things do not purify man, unless... he performs repentance by desisting from his sins.
In performing repentance, man must look to the Lord alone...
No repentance in a state of disease, Explained.
For repentance precedes remission; and without repentance there is no remission; and therefore the Lord commanded... to preach repentance for the remission of sins. Illustrated.
If man commits evil of set purpose, he lets himself deep down, and cannot be drawn out except by actual repentance.
The two essentials and universals of religion are the acknowledgement of God, and repentance. Explained. AR 9.
This is repentance of life with such.
Preface. 4. The Roman Catholic doctrine of repentance. Quoted. (And that of the Reformed. Va.)
Instead of repentance of life, there is now repentance of mouth...
The New Church is being formed of those who approach the Lord alone, and at the same time perform repentance from evil works. AR 72, Illustrated.
The good done without repentance is not good.
Tormented until the overseer sees a sign of penitence.

The Angels said... Unless man performs repentance, he remains in the sins in which he was born. To perform repentance is not to will evils because they are against God, and, once or twice a year, to scrutinize one's self, to see one's evils, to confess them before the Lord, to implore aid, to desist from them, and to enter upon a new life.
Everyone who performs repentance, and believes in the Lord, is being... regenerated.
The man who looks to the Lord, and performs repentance, is by (the Holy Supper) conjoined with the Lord and introduced into Heaven.
Such never think about repentance, and an unrepentant man is in mere sins.
Yet repented not of the works of their hands () = neither did they shun... evils as sins. AR 461. Signified, Explained. AE 585. AE 589.
For (solifidians) say, What need of repentance... AR 461.
The second Table is the Table of repentance. Explained.
By such things (the Israelites) represented repentance.

They said (of Swedenborg), Lo, he who preached repentance for the remission of sins... lies dead in the street... How can repentance be performed without faith?... After three days and a half my spirit recovered, and I went into the city, and again said, Perform repentance, and believe in Christ, and your sins will be remitted... Did not the Lord Himself preach repentance for the remission of sins?... But they said... Has not the Father justified us who believe... What sin then is there in us?... Do you comprehend this gospel, you preacher of... repentance? A voice from Heaven then said, What is the faith of the unrepentant but a dead one? The end has come upon you secure ones...
Have we not performed repentance when we have confessed that we are sinners?

A voice from Heaven said... Actual repentance is to explore self, to Know and acknowledge your evils, to make yourselves guilty, to confess them before the Lord, to implore aid and power to resist them, and thus to desist from them, and lead a new life, and all these as of yourselves. Do these things once or twice in a year when you approach the holy Communion; and afterwards, when the sins... recur, say to yourselves, We do not will these things because they are sins against God. This is actual repentance.

The Reformed have a deep-rooted opposition, repugnance, and aversion to actual repentance, which is so great that they cannot compel themselves to explore themselves... It is faith alone which induces such a state of unrepentance.

A voice from Heaven said, Say to the congregation of the Reformed, Believe in Christ, and perform repentance, and you will be saved... I further said to them, Is not baptism a sacrament of repentance?... Is not the Holy Supper a sacrament of repentance?... Is not the Catechism... a teacher of repentance? Explained.

These are they who do not... perform repentance, and are therefore damned. Signified. I have seen many such... who had avoided evils... solely from the civil and moral law... and they were cast into Hell.
For evils increase daily if not removed by actual repentance.

The delights of evil cannot be removed by the Lord unless the man explores himself, so as to know his evils, acknowledges and confesses them before the Lord, wills to desist from them, and thus performs repentance...
Who now performs any repentance, except orally and in prayer?
Valuable sayings about the acts of repentance, etc., which are the exteriors of the doctrine of faith alone, for the sake of the laity. TCR 518.
Concupiscence, when in the will, is a deed, and cannot be removed except by the Lord after repentance. Explained.
In place of repentance we have taken contrition.
On Repentance. Chapter.
For true faith, and genuine charity, are not possible without repentance, and no one can perform repentance without free will.

No one can be regenerated until the more grievous evils... have been removed, and these are removed by repentance. What is an unregenerate man but an unrepentant one? And what is an unrepentant one but like one who is in a lethargy, and knows nothing of sin, and therefore cherishes it in his bosom...
That repentance is the first of the Church with man. General article.
Acts of repentance are all such as cause man not to will evils, and thence not do them...

(Thus) for repentance to be repentance, and to be effective in man, it must be of the will and thence of the thought, and not of the thought alone; consequently, for it to be actual, and not only oral.

That repentance is the first of the Church. Illustrated... John... preached repentance, and therefore his baptism was called the baptism of repentance. Explained. The Lord Himself preached repentance for the remission of sins; whereby He taught that repentance is the first of the Church, and that in proportion as man performs repentance, the sins with him are removed... And He commanded the twelve apostles, and also the seventy, to preach repentance.
That (modern) contrition is not repentance. General article.

The Reformed assumed contrition in place of repentance, to sever themselves from the Roman Catholics, who insist upon repentance... and after they had confirmed... faith alone, they alleged that by repentance something of man, savouring of merit, entered his faith.
That the oral confession that one is a sinner, is not repentance. General article.
This confession was accepted by the Reformed in place of actual repentance... because it is founded on their imputative faith, which... without repentance... regenerates man.
Some of them can... pour forth many holy things about repentance... while they deem it useless... for they mean no other repentance than an oral confession...
That man is born to evils of every kind, and unless, by repentance, he removes them in part, he remains in them... and cannot be saved. General article.
That the Knowledge of sin, and the exploration of some sin in one's self, begins repentance. General article.
That actual repentance is to explore one's self, to Know and acknowledge one's sins, to supplicate to the Lord, and to begin a new life. General article. TCR 561.
That repentance must be performed, and that the salvation of man depends upon it. Illustrated.
How, then, is repentance to be performed? Actually, which is, to explore self, etc... This is actual repentance.
Actual repentance, if performed... for instance, as often as a man prepares for the Holy Supper, if he afterwards abstains from one sin... suffices to initiate into actuality...
That true repentance is to explore not only the acts... but also the intentions... General article.
He (then) performs true and interior repentance. Explained.

That those also perform repentance who do not explore themselves, but still desist from evils because they are sins; and that this repentance is performed by those who do works of charity from religion. General article.

As actual repentance is extremely difficult in the Reformed Christian world... a more easy species of repentance is adduced, which is, that when anyone is considering about evil, and intending it, he should say to himself, I am thinking and intending this, but as it is a sin I will not do it. By this the temptation injected by Hell is broken, and its further entrance prevented.
Inquiry was made... as to who could practise this second kind (of repentance), and they were found to be as few as the doves in a spacious desert...
That actual repentance is easy with those who have sometimes practised it; but is extremely refractory with those who have not. General article.
Actual repentance is extremely refractory to the Reformed. Explained. TCR 562. (And also to Roman Catholics who live in Protestant countries. TCR 562:3.)
That he who has never performed repentance... at last does not know what damnable evil is, and what saving good. General article.
Of the quality of your internal man you know nothing, because you have not... after self-exploration, performed repentance.
Man is constantly kept in a state in which repentance and conversion are possible.
Thus by serious repentance...
(What the Protestants call repentance.) Described. ConvCalvin 7:8.
To perform repentance = actually to turn away from evil. AE 585:3, Explained. AE 589.
To repent in sackcloth and ashes () = to grieve and mourn on account of the nonreception of Divine truth, and of the evils and falsities which obstructed.
God cannot be reconciled except by the repentance of the man himself.
Sins are not abolished except by the repentance of life of him who has sinned.
Cannot be removed except by serious and actual repentance of life.
Which is done by repentance. Explained.
In the same proportion can perform repentance from sins, Explained.
That good before repentance is spurious good... Explained.
Such as is the... removal of evil by repentance, such is the good of charity. Explained.
Holy Spirit. 4. 9. (The Divine proceeds) through the Holy Supper according to the repentance before it.
